caption: The drawing depicts a group of eight human figures and one dog arranged indoors on a wooden floor against a plain brown background. On the left, a man in a black suit sits on a black chair, holding a newspaper in his left hand. Below him, a brown-and-white dog lies curled up on the floor. To the man's right, there are seven individuals, consisting of women and children. Immediately next to the man sits a girl in a floral-patterned, brownish dress with a lace collar. Behind her stands a young male in dark attire with a white collar, and to his right, a woman in a light dress with a white collar and leads to another woman in similar fashion, both standing. Next to them, another girl in a light blue dress with a floral pattern is seated on a chair, her hands placed on her lap. To her right, an older woman with a lace-trimmed white bonnet and dark dress is seated, and a small child in a bright red dress with a pattern sits on her lap. The final figure, a young girl in a tan-and-brown patterned dress, stands at the rightmost edge of the group. All figures face forward, and the colors in the drawing are muted earth tones, with clothing in black, brown, beige, white, light blue, and red. The placement of the group forms a slightly curved row, and there are no visible objects or decorations in the background.
title: John J. Wagner Family Portrait
